residuals.location: right photo join near glass mullion
residuals.observation: The editorial change of crop is absorbed by the glass-frame geometry; a distinct photo splice is less visible than in the planned construction.

residuals.location: far upper right reflected blue rectangular area
residuals.observation: Very small pale, unreadable sign-like strokes remain despite requested removal. No additional wording can be transcribed.
First small-scale read confused the coda ㄷ/ㄹ; one native revisit resolves it as ㄷ, while the small-scale ambiguity remains a typographic limit.

located_observations.observation: Title retains the immediate two-line dark serif anchor; diagonal curb, broad shadow and reflection remain substantive image forms.
Four larger sans body lines sit directly below the title at the same left start. Commas and periods are distinguishable, and line starts can be followed without searching.

located_observations.location: curb left end and body right edge
located_observations.observation: Curb starts farther right, beyond the enlarged paragraph's longest line. The last body line ends above the heavy shadow. Worn stone remains visible behind the text.
Distinct stone pits, worn joints, diagonal low curb, long off-frame shadow, warm metallic frame and cooler layered street reflection preserve the photographic close-observation character.

layout.fidelity: First word soft-wrap; remaining two words on the second line.

ambiguity.description: Initial small-scale title first-glyph coda ㄷ/ㄹ

revisit.resolution: At native scale the coda shows top and bottom horizontal strokes joined on the left and open to the right, resolving ㄷ rather than a ㄹ middle zigzag.
revisit.reason: One same-pinned-original revisit for title glyph class and incomplete initial native tool display.

style.checked_requirement: 낮은 시선의 빛과 발걸음 — sharp observational photo joining near pavement traces and cooler mid-distance reflection
style.observations: Close worn stone, long pedestrian shadow, thin light on low curb and layered reflection form a coherent warm/cool photograph. Serif title and regular sans body retain mature editorial contrast; splice remains subdued.

ratio.policy_observation: Nearest-integer rounding within the declared0.5px tolerance; native preserved without resizing.

substantive_visual.location: lower two thirds and right glass
substantive_visual.observation: Stone wear and joints, passing-person shadow, oblique low sun and a reflected walker/street express attentive urban observation beyond glyph forms.

hangul.title: Stable serif proportions and wide counters; native ㄷ read resolved, small-scale ambiguity recorded.
hangul.body: Regular sans, even visual baseline/weight and meaningful word spaces. Actual body looks approximately14–16px high at usage720, larger and easier to follow than initial; this is a visual estimate, not a font-size measurement.

information_relationship.observed_route: Two-line title → adjacent same-axis four-line paragraph → stone joints/diagonal curb → reflection
information_relationship.observed_change: Larger body and more separated lines reduce the initial sharp fall in reading scale.

material_edge_finish.observations: Stone pits and joint wear, diagonal curb bevel, warm metal frame and cooler glass reflection remain differentiated. Foreground stone and curb geometry changed during edit; photographic material character is preserved.

basic_style_exclusion.observations: Photo perspective, shadow, sunlit curb and reflection organize the whole large image. Text is part of the light-boundary relationship; no independent solid information panel, subordinate tiny picture or empty-room dressing.
